message:
I hear ya, Mike.  When I moved to WP, I was really intimidated by PHP and would not have been able to do a thing without Harrison and Wolfangel.  When Bloghosts just recently announced that they were shutting down on Jan. 1 and I was faced with moving my WP blog elsewhere, I really didn't think I'd be able to do it.  WA's recent entries on the problems she was having with her own words were greek to me!  Since I'd been wanting to burn the old blog anyway, it was a good time to go back to Typepad.

I wanted to be one of the cool kids and do the Open Source thang, really I did, but I just don't have the technical know-how.
